summary: System shows strong architectural patterns for modernization platform but legacy VB6 banking code presents critical security vulnerabilities requiring immediate remediation during modernization.

hotspots.reason: SQL injection vulnerabilities in both check balance and deposit operations
No error handling or validation in banking operations

provenance.evidence: No try-catch blocks or input validation in VB6 code

hotspots.reason: Deposit operation lacks transaction management and rollback capability

risks.title: Critical SQL Injection Vulnerability
risks.description: Legacy VB6 banking operations use direct string concatenation for SQL queries, allowing potential unauthorized access to customer account data and balance manipulation

risks.title: Data Integrity Risk
risks.description: Deposit operations lack proper transaction management, potentially leading to inconsistent account balances during system failures

risks.title: Audit Trail Gap
risks.description: No logging or audit mechanisms for banking operations, preventing compliance with financial regulations

risks.title: Input Validation Missing
risks.description: No validation of account numbers or deposit amounts, allowing invalid or malicious data entry
